name: caracol
description: Snail racing betting app: React client and Express API.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
